set.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Volume grids and mesh realizations use the same spatial4s nominal frame types without converting between competing frame algebras.
- Shared neuroimaging declarations have an external owner; generic directional transform capabilities live in reframe4s.
- A coherent provider revision set passes wrong-frame, unit/convention, directionality, scanner/tkRAS and transform-oracle checks.

Close after its child implementation tasks and their evidence satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.
set.title: U2 milestone: Share one coordinate and world-frame model
